title: Malicious code in @xzvbailss/xzgateway (npm)
description: The npm package @xzvbailss/xzgateway contains malicious code that compromises any computer on which it is installed or running. The compromise is severe enough that all secrets and keys stored on the affected computer should be rotated immediately from a separate, secure machine. Removal of the package alone may not fully eliminate the malicious presence, as the attacker may have established persistent control over the system.
